title: Category
description: Canonical category schema v1.2. Normalizes category/collection data from Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce, and BigCommerce. Unicommerce does not have a category API — categoryCode on products is a plain string only.

id.description: Your internal unique category ID. Generated by your system. Must be unique.

sourceId.description: Original category ID from the platform.

x-source.bigcommerce: category.id converted to string from GET /v2/catalog/trees/{id}/categories

source.description: Which platform this category came from. 'internal' = manually defined. Unicommerce excluded — no category API.

storeId.description: Which store this category belongs to. Categories are per-store. Must exist in store schema.

name.description: Display name of the category. Must not be empty.

slug.description: URL-friendly version of the category name. Must be URL-safe if present.

x-source.bigcommerce: category.url from category tree API — strip leading/trailing slashes

parentId.description: Internal canonical ID of the parent category. Null = top-level. Populate after full category tree is ingested.

x-source.shopify: null — collections are flat, no hierarchy
x-source.magento: category.parent_id converted to string — set null if parent_id === 1 (root sentinel)
x-source.woocommerce: category.parent converted to string — set null if parent === 0 (root sentinel)
x-source.bigcommerce: category.parent_id from tree API — set null if 0

level.description: Depth in category tree. 0 = top-level visible category. Must be >= 0.

x-source.magento: category.level — NOTE: levels 0 and 1 are internal system nodes, skip them. Real merchant categories start at level 2
x-source.woocommerce: derived: parent === 0 → 0, else 1. WooCommerce does not provide level natively
x-source.bigcommerce: derived from parent_id depth in tree — calculate during ingestion

description.description: Plain text category description. Strip HTML if present.

x-source.bigcommerce: category.description from tree API — strip HTML

description.example: All footwear products including shoes, sandals, and boots.

imageUrl.description: Category banner or thumbnail image URL.

x-source.magento: not available in category API response

productCount.description: Number of products in this category. Informational only — not used for business logic. Must be >= 0.

x-source.bigcommerce: not directly available — derive by counting products with this category

x-source.shopify: hardcode true — all published collections are active
x-source.woocommerce: hardcode true — WooCommerce does not expose inactive categories via API

includeInMenu.description: Whether this category appears in store navigation. Magento only.

path.description: Full ancestor path as slash-separated IDs. Magento only. Useful for breadcrumb generation.

children.description: List of child category sourceIds under this category. ALWAYS an array, never null. Empty array if leaf node.

x-source.magento: category.children.split(',').filter(Boolean) — NOTE: children is a comma-separated string, not array
x-source.woocommerce: derive by finding all categories where parent === this.sourceId
x-source.bigcommerce: derive from tree API by finding categories where parent_id === this.sourceId

position.description: Display sort order among sibling categories. Lower = first.

availableSortBy.description: Sort options available for this category page. Magento only. ALWAYS an array, never null.

treeId.description: BigCommerce only. The category tree ID this category belongs to. BigCommerce supports multiple trees per store.

createdAt.description: When this category was created on the source platform.

updatedAt.description: When this category was last modified on the source platform.

lastSyncedAt.description: When your system last synced this category tree. Null if never synced.
